subtopics.title: 2026 Dirac Medal winners
subtopics.summary: Indian physicist Deepak Dhar won the 2026 Dirac Medal alongside three other physicists, including Bernard Derrida and Haim Sompolinsky. The recognition was for pioneering work in statistical mechanics. This subtopic covers who won and the field of their work.

subtopics.title: Dirac Medal: award details
subtopics.summary: The Dirac Medal is an annual award instituted in 1985 and presented by the International Centre for Theoretical Physics. It honours the legacy of Paul Dirac. Each recipient receives US$5,000 along with the medal.

subtopics.title: Paul Dirac and the 1933 Nobel Prize
subtopics.summary: Paul Dirac is described as a renowned physicist and one of the founders of modern quantum mechanics. He received the 1933 Nobel Prize in Physics jointly with Erwin Schrödinger. The Dirac Medal honours his legacy.

quizzes.passage: The Dirac Medal is an annual award that honours the legacy of the renowned physicist Paul Dirac. Dirac is remembered as one of the founders of modern quantum mechanics, and the medal carries his name in recognition of his influence on the subject. In 2026, the medal was awarded to the physicist Deepak Dhar, who shared the honour with three other physicists. The recognition was given for pioneering work in statistical mechanics, the field in which their research lies. Each recipient of the award receives a medal, which marks the honour in a tangible form. The award is given every year, and the 2026 medal is the latest of these presentations.
